data.one_liner: Dart library to parse and render text templates with variables and custom tags.
data.what_it_does: TemplateEngine parses template text into a parse tree and renders it to various outputs such as HTML, Markdown, JSON, YAML, XML, or custom code. It supports statements, expressions, loops, conditionals, and custom grammar extensions.
use_when: Generating static HTML or Markdown from templates
Creating code snippets or scripts via templating
Automating report generation with variable data
avoid_when: Building UI widgets that require reactive updates
Replacing a full templating engine with a simple string interpolation
Using it for large-scale data processing where performance is critical
strengths: Supports multiple output formats out of the box
Simple API for parsing and rendering
weaknesses: No built-in caching or performance optimizations
